answer: Cosignatures are collected in jade, verified in tundra, and sable names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 49 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 221 dollars and 15 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
